There are no tables in the source document.

In Section 7 (page 7), the main list structure is broken. The source shows three primary request items marked with circles, where the first item contains sub-bullets. The output renders the first item as a paragraph, follows it with a list of the sub-bullets, and then renders the subsequent two primary items as separate bolded paragraphs. This loses the structural grouping of the three main requests.
